notes: All evidence leads are unverified arc-level recollection; no chapter references are given.
Every record is Draft or Held. Independent review and verification are still required.
Role scores are omitted; the scoring engine derives them. IDs are provisional.
Power anchors are those of batch 001 (NARUTO-POWER-ANCHORS-0.1).

characters.name: Hashirama Senju
characters.canonical_version: Prime First Hokage (founding era): Wood Release, Sage Mode
characters.justification: Founded Konoha by uniting clans; Wood Release gives benchmark offense, large-scale defense and terrain control; subdued Kurama. Healing limited to cell transfer used by others.

evidence_leads.lead: Valley of the End fight with Madara (flashback)

characters.name: Kaguya Otsutsuki
characters.canonical_version: Rabbit Goddess state (war arc)
characters.justification: Dimension shifting, Byakugan and Truth-Seeking Orbs give near-unmatched offense and defense; no cooperative or healing role.

evidence_leads.lead: Final battle with Team 7, war arc

characters.name: Hagoromo Otsutsuki
characters.canonical_version: Sage of Six Paths prime (flashback; spirit appearance in war arc)
characters.justification: Founder of ninshu who sealed the Ten-Tails and empowered Naruto and Sasuke; evidence is flashback and spirit-state only.

evidence_leads.lead: Naruto and Sasuke empowerment scene, war arc

characters.name: Obito Uchiha
characters.canonical_version: War-era Obito before the Ten-Tails jinchuriki state: Kamui, Wood Release, Rinnegan
characters.justification: Architect of the war plan; Kamui, Wood Release and Rinnegan give strong offense, infiltration and transport. Jinchuriki state excluded as a one-time external transformation.

characters.name: Nagato
characters.canonical_version: Pain's Assault arc: Six Paths of Pain through the Rinnegan; Rinne Tensei excluded
characters.justification: Rinnegan bodies give overwhelming offense and area control. Rinne Tensei revival is fatal and excluded, so Healer is 0 (would be 5 if counted).

characters.name: Minato Namikaze
characters.canonical_version: Prime Fourth Hokage: Flying Thunder God, Rasengan; Reaper Death Seal excluded
characters.justification: Hokage leader; Flying Thunder God gives targeted kills, rescue and transport; weak durability.

evidence_leads.lead: Konoha attack flashback (Obito fight, sealing Kurama)

characters.name: Tobirama Senju
characters.canonical_version: Prime Second Hokage (founding era): Water Release, Flying Thunder God
characters.justification: Inventor of the Flying Thunder God and village systems; strong tactician and sensor. Battlefield evidence is mostly Edo Tensei.

characters.name: Itachi Uchiha
characters.canonical_version: Akatsuki-era Itachi (illness remains a limit); Edo state excluded
characters.justification: ANBU captain and clan operation show benchmark targeted elimination; genjutsu, Susanoo and Amaterasu give strong offense; long-term planning.

characters.name: Hamura Otsutsuki
characters.canonical_version: Hamura Otsutsuki (brief flashback)
characters.justification: Appears briefly alongside Hagoromo; abilities largely unestablished, so ratings are placeholders.

characters.name: Indra Otsutsuki
characters.canonical_version: Indra Otsutsuki (flashback)
characters.justification: Susanoo-era power and tactical skill shown only in flashback; placeholders pending evidence.

evidence_leads.lead: Indra and Ashura flashback, war arc

characters.name: Ashura Otsutsuki
characters.canonical_version: Ashura Otsutsuki (flashback)
characters.justification: Chakra-of-cooperation legacy shown only in flashback; placeholders pending evidence.

evidence_leads.lead: Indra and Ashura flashback, war arc

characters.name: Gyuki
characters.canonical_version: Eight-Tails Gyuki as independent beast (war arc)
characters.justification: Large chakra, Tailed Beast Bombs and durability; advises Killer B. Partner-dependent modes are excluded from independent feats.

characters.name: Hiruzen Sarutobi
characters.canonical_version: Prime Third Hokage; war-era Edo evidence; Shinigami seal excluded
characters.justification: Decades as Hokage with broad ninjutsu mastery; tactician against Orochimaru. Dead Demon Consuming Seal excluded as fatal.

characters.name: Jiraiya
characters.canonical_version: Pain's Assault-era Jiraiya: Sage Mode, toad summons, spy network
characters.justification: Sannin with Sage Mode, Rasengan and toad summons; continent-wide spymaster; strong offense, moderate strategy.

characters.name: Orochimaru
characters.canonical_version: Part II Orochimaru with restored arms; Edo Tensei user
characters.justification: Scientist-strategist with Edo Tensei plans, snake techniques, infiltration and self-only body regeneration.

characters.name: Might Guy
characters.canonical_version: War-era Might Guy: Gates through the Seventh; Eighth Gate excluded
characters.justification: Taijutsu master with Gate-enhanced offense; protects teammates in front-line fights. Eighth Gate excluded.

characters.name: Kabuto Yakushi
characters.canonical_version: Part II Kabuto with Sage Mode and Edo Tensei (own ability)
characters.justification: Spy-medic and Edo Tensei user; Sage Mode and Orochimaru-cell abilities; competent healer of others, regeneration self-only.

characters.name: Gaara
characters.canonical_version: War-era Gaara after Shukaku extraction: sand control without Shukaku-only abilities
characters.justification: Alliance commander; sand shield protects allies; sand manipulation retained. Shukaku-dependent absolute defense excluded.

characters.name: Killer B
characters.canonical_version: War-era Killer B with Gyuki partnership (Conditional)
characters.justification: Jinchuriki with Tailed Beast Bombs and swordsmanship; partner-dependent power is Conditional.

characters.name: Onoki
characters.canonical_version: War-era Third Tsuchikage: Dust Release
characters.justification: Tsuchikage and Alliance commander; Dust Release disintegrates targets; flight aids transport.

characters.name: Mu
characters.canonical_version: Edo-only: First Tsuchikage, Particle Style (living prime inferred)
characters.justification: Particle Style Atomic Dismantling; evidence is Edo Tensei only.

characters.name: Gengetsu Hozuki
characters.canonical_version: Edo-only: Second Mizukage, Steam Release (living prime inferred)
characters.justification: Steam Release offense seen through Edo Tensei only.

characters.name: Third Raikage
characters.canonical_version: Edo-only: Third Raikage, lightning armor
characters.justification: Lightning armor and thrust attacks with notable durability; evidence is Edo Tensei only.

characters.name: Fourth Raikage
characters.canonical_version: War-era Fourth Raikage (A): lightning armor
characters.justification: Raikage and Alliance leader with Lightning Release armor, speed and strength.

characters.name: Kisame Hoshigaki
characters.canonical_version: Akatsuki-era Kisame with Samehada
characters.justification: Huge chakra, Water Release and Samehada chakra absorption; strong frontline fighter.

characters.name: Sasori
characters.canonical_version: Sasori arc: puppeteer with the Third Kazekage puppet
characters.justification: Puppet and poison specialist with targeted lethal poison; no healing evidence (antidote knowledge is not healing).

characters.name: Deidara
characters.canonical_version: Akatsuki-era Deidara: explosive clay
characters.justification: Strong explosive offense; little leadership or durability.

characters.name: Kakuzu
characters.canonical_version: Akatsuki-era Kakuzu with multiple hearts
characters.justification: Durable multi-element fighter with tactical sense; self-only recovery.

characters.name: Konan
characters.canonical_version: Pain's Assault-era Konan: paper techniques
characters.justification: Paper clones and wings give offense, scouting and transport for Akatsuki.

characters.name: Danzo Shimura
characters.canonical_version: Five Kage Summit-era Danzo: borrowed Sharingan, Izanagi, Wood arm
characters.justification: Root leader and schemer with varied techniques; Izanagi as limited self-only resilience.

characters.name: Chiyo
characters.canonical_version: Sasori arc Chiyo: puppets; Selfless Reincarnation excluded (fatal)
characters.justification: Skilled puppeteer and advisor. Selfless Reincarnation revives another but is fatal and excluded, so Healer is 1 (would be 5 if counted).

characters.name: Hanzo
characters.canonical_version: Prime Hanzo of the Salamander (flashback and Edo evidence)
characters.justification: Feared leader of Amegakure who held his own against the Sannin; evidence from flashback and Edo.

evidence_leads.lead: Part I and II Sannin flashbacks
